message.content: This image is a minimalist graphic composition featuring a single, perfectly round circle centered within a square frame. The circle is a solid, highly saturated shade of bright red, showing no textures, gradients, or variations in tone. The entire background is a uniform, plain white, providing a sharp and high-contrast backdrop for the red disc. The red sun figure occupies a significant portion of the frame but is completely surrounded by the white field, which extends to all edges of the image. There are no other objects, text, symbols, or patterns present. The style is clean, simple, and iconic, characteristic of a national flag design.
